tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /drug pa tshes bzhi'i dge rtsa'i chos spyod sgrigs rim bzhugs// dge tsha tshes bzhi'i nyin tshogs 'phral dkar cha bzhi mdzad/ de nas bla mchod kyi steng du dpal mchog ma/ gang drin ma/ dus 'khor brgyud 'debs/ mgon po'i brgyud 'debs/ yongs 'dzin/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rje sangs rin pa/ zha lu lo chen rnams kyi sku bstod rgyas pa/ rab mdzes ma gdangs ma thung tsam la/ legs bshad nor bu nas thung du btong / sngags 'chang chen po'i bla ma so so'i sku bstod rnams dang / byin rlabs char 'bebs la/ shes bya kun la ma brgya tshar 'gro nges dang gdangs ring dang bcas pa/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma gdangs ma/ /byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma brgya tshar 'gro nges/ grags pas mkha' khyab ma brgya tshar 'gro nges/ legs pa'i 'byung gnas ma gdangs ma/ sku mched rnams kyi bstod pa rgyas bsdus rnams dang / rje mus chen gyi sku bstod brgya tshar/ sku bstod rgyas pa gdangs ma/ spyan snga rin po che'i sku bstod rnams/ smon lam bkra shis dkyus bzhin grub rjes gung sangs mdzad/ ja dang po zhogs ja la skal bzang ma/ ja gnyis pa mang ja chen mo yod na he ru ka pa/ mang ja chen mo med na gnyis pa skor ja gcig gtong / de nas gung seng bsdus la bla mchod gzhung bsrang la maṇḍal sogs dang / thos rgya ma gdangs ring sogs dkyus ma bzhin dang / gsang chen ma'i rjes la/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs yan lag bdun pa'i rjes su/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs kyi bkra shis dang / gung seng mdzad/ gung seng bsdus nas de 'phral tsha ja la ja mchod gang rigs dang / gsol ba chos spyod tshan brgya mgo mjug gi sgrigs rim rnams dang bcas pa dang / rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse ma sogs sngags 'chang chen po'i bla ma rnams kyi sku bstod dang / sngags 'chang yab sras gsum dang / sku mched gsum dang / rje mus chen sogs kyi sku bstod rgyas pa/ gsang chen ma dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang /

sogs dang / smon lam dang bkra shis mdor bsdus mdzad nas/ gsol ba mdzad bar la/ gsol khrung dang / gsol zho zhu/ de nas skor ja song rjes gsol bsdu/ gung seng mdzad/ de nas gung seng bsdus la/ lam 'bras phyag mchod gdangs ma dang / gsol gting ma la ja mchod oṃ las ma/ maṇḍal dang / gang gi mchod rdzas ma gdangs ma/ de nas deng nas byang chub sogs dang / bdag gis thog med dus sogs lam 'bras phyag mchod 'brel/ smon lam tshigs bcad ma dang / phyogs bcu dus gsum ma dang / dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che sogs thos rgya ma gdangs med/ smon lam mdor bsdus dang / sems brtse ma gdangs med gcig dang / gdangs ma gcig gdangs med gcig de bzhin gshegs pa sogs dang / khyed la bstod cing sogs mdzad/ byams pa'i bstod pa byams pa'i dkyil 'khor tshig bcad gcig dang / 'jam dbyangs la gang gi blo gros ma dang / phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas sogs dang / dkon mchog rin chen dang / bla ma sku khams bzang ba sogs dang / sku bsod ri bo sogs dang / de nas rgyan drug mchog gcig lo tsā ba/ rgyal mes dbon rnams gsum gyi bstod pa rnams mdzad pa'i rgyan drug sogs kyi bstod pa gdangs ma kho na mdzad/ de nas a la la te ma/ dad chu ma/ dkon mchog rgyal po'i bstod pa/ tshangs dbang gdangs ma/ srid dral ma shur ma gnyis dang gdangs ma gcig mdzad pa la bar ma la gdangs mdzad/ chos rnams ma brgya tshar/ chos rgyal ma'i gdangs ring tshar ba dang / 'phags bstod che chung / bla ma dam pa/ theg chen pa/ g.yag rong rnams kyi bstod pa dang / rgya chen ma/ rab mdzes ma sogs sngags 'chang chen po'i bla ma so so'i sku bstod/ shes bya ma sogs yab sras gsum dang / mus chen/ spyan snga rin po che rnams kyi sku bstod shlau ka re/ yon tan tshad med ma/ dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi sogs dang / bla ma sku khams sogs dang / sku bsod ri bo mdzad nas gung seng mdzad/ gsol ba grol man ja rgyab la zho dang chang 'grim shal zhu/

gung seng bsdus nas rgyud ja la ja mchod mdor na ma sogs gang rigs dang / dad pa'i rba rlabs ma gdangs ma/ thub bstan gser khang ma/ rgya chen ma tshar gsum/ skye ba kun du sogs dang / rgyal ba'i rigs bdag ma dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi gcig yongs rdzogs/ zab yangs ma gdangs ma/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sogs sngags 'chang chen po'i bla ma rnams kyi sku bstod/ shes bya ma/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma/ dus phyis sku mched gnyis kyi bstod gsar gdangs ma re mdzad/ legs pa'i 'byung gnas ma rnams dang / sku mched gsum gyi sku bstod/ mus chen/ spyan snga rin po che rnams kyi sku bstod dkon mchog rin chen sogs gong bzhin smon lam bkra shis mdzad nas gung seng mdzad/ de nas dro ja thog dkar spro bzhugs gral mdzad/ gung seng bsdus nas dgong ja'i steng ja mchod ji ltar rigs pa dang / smon lam rnam bzhi'i ltung bshags/ mi mjed ma bzang spyod/ 'gro la bde skyid ma/ smon lam dang / bkra shis skor re ma mdzad/ mi mjed ma dang / 'gro la bde skyid ma lo re bzhin gdang re mos gang yod de mdzad ces pa 'di ni sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis// ༈ //dge rtsa'i skabs kyi 'jim pa byin rlabs byed tshul bzhugs/ pad zla'i steng du 'jim pa byang chub las rin po che'i phung por gyur/ bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'og min rnam snang la phog ste gsol ba btab/ de yi thugs kha'i 'od kyis sems can gyi rgyud sbyangs shing / 'jim pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bai ro tsa na pra bha rā dza ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arha te samyaka saṃ buddha ya/ tadya tha sukṣ+me sukṣ+me sa ma ye shante dante/ sa ma ro be/ a na laṃ bhe/ ta raṃ bha ya shwa ba ni mahā te dza ni ra ku le/ ni ra bha ne sarba buddha a dhiṣṭhi te swāhā/ zhes nyer gcig brjod cing byin gyis brlab bo/

/sngags bzlas bar la lag pa gnyis ka'i mthe chung mthe bos mnan/ gung mdzub srin lag gsum gshib te bsgreng pa kha sbyar ba'i rtse mo 'jim pa'i phung po la reg cing reg theng lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bya'o zhes pa 'di yang ngag dbang kun dgas smras so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ drug pa tshes bzhi'i dge rtsa'i chos spyod sgrig rim/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
